methodology_corrections_v2_1.dqn_retraining: Trained exclusively on 2016-2024 development transitions. Zero 2025 observations or rewards.
methodology_corrections_v2_1.meta_ensemble_stacking: Fitted exclusively on chronological walk-forward out-of-fold (OOF) predictions within 2016-2024. 2025 completely excluded.

core_model_training.description: 2016-2024 Model Development Universe: 2,130 training bars after 119 warmup bars and 15 incomplete-label bars dropped (zero 2025/2026 data used)

scaler_fitting.description: Asset-specific StandardScaler fitted exclusively on AAPL 2016-2024 development samples (2,130 bars, 27 features). Fully aligned with live inference.

downstream_calibration.description: Probability calibrator fitted strictly on H1 2025 validation subset and evaluated independently on H2 2025.

meta_ensemble_training.description: ElasticNet Logistic Regression fitted strictly on out-of-fold predictions within 2016-2024 development period. 2025 completely excluded.

dqn_rl_training.description: Deep Q-Network sequential policy replay trained exclusively on 2016-2024 development transitions. Rewards derived from 2016-2024 triple-barrier labels. Replay buffer and gradient updates restricted strictly to development data.

hyperparameter_optimization.description: Clean Optuna study for barrier ATR multipliers (1.5x TP, 2.0x SL, 15d horizon), tree parameters, cooldown, and threshold strictly within 2016-2024 development universe

historical_optimization_provenance_audit.finding: Historical runs prior to commit 4b3013b used datetime.now(), consuming 2025-2026 data. Retrained cleanly on 2016-2024.

prospective_validation.description: Untouched forward out-of-sample paper trading experiment strictly from 2026-10-01 16:00:00 EDT onward protected by hard firewall

exit_rules.long_exit: SELL signal closes LONG unconditionally (decoupled from macro bear filter)

timestamp_policy.vix_treatment: VIX[t-1] strictly lagged by 1 trading session (zero post-16:00 ET leak)
timestamp_policy.execution_window: Next trading session Open[t+1] at 09:30:00 ET
